title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重八十六章 青龙云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重八十七章 石洞
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
天海骤暗，蜃气骤然消失。过了一会儿，当那蜃楼幻景再度出现时，白衣女子已骑乘着凤凰，回旋海上，与先前出现过的那条青鳞巨龙穿梭激斗。
那巨龙时而直冲云霄，喷火如霞;时而翻江倒海，吞波吸浪，虽明知只是幻影，但听着那惊天动地的咆哮，众人仍不免为其凶威所慑，心惊胆跳，难以集中念力。
惟有王文卿、林灵素、李少微三人不为所动，聚气斗法，头顶白汽蒸腾，衣衫均被汗水浸透。
林灵素与李少微均已臻散仙之境，彼此又心意相通，若在从前，双剑合璧，威力暴增，别说王文卿的五行太一霓电阵，就算是道门四大剑仙联手，也未必能敌。但此时经脉尽断，凭着两伤法术才勉力强撑，耗时越久，对他们越是不利。
王文卿看穿此节，因此也不急于求成，只是聚引剑阵，封堵雷电光，不让那“两仪电剑”导入许宣、小青的身体，形成人剑合一之势。待到林李二人意念涣散，或真气稍有松竭之时，再发力猛攻。
又听“隆隆”轰鸣，夜空中突然霞光四射，刺得众人难以睁眼。凝眸细辨，只见蜃景中，青龙怒吼飞扬，巨尾狂飚似的扫中凤凰，将那神鸟打得血肉模糊，断羽纷飞。
白衣女子身子一晃，腰部以下竟化为蛇形，右手取出一个五色石头，冲天抛起。那石头急速飞旋，甩出万道绚光，朝着青龙呼啸撞下。
“五色石”林灵素的手掌蓦地一抖，脱口低呼。李少微脸色亦陡然一变
几在同时，众船上惊哗四起，有人叫道：“女娲是女娲在镇伏青龙”许宣大奇，忍不住抬头上望。
女娲伏龙距今已有万年，为何竟会出现在这蜃景之中？若仅是虚妄幻影，何以如此栩栩如生？如果是真实返照，岂不意味着林灵素所言非虚，这里当真是女娲降龙的所在？当真是千古以来，人们苦苦寻之而不得的蓬莱？
霓光流舞，照得海面幻丽难言。众人都和他一般，怔怔仰望，又是惊喜又是骇异，阴晴不定。
又听“轰”的一声巨响，空中霞光怒爆，女娲、青龙……尽皆烟消云散。那两道滚滚交缠的炽光突然剥茧抽丝般离心飞甩，土崩瓦解，被周围众剑抽吸得一于二净。
许宣眼前一黑，周身如被山岳压成粉末，“哇”地喷出一大口鲜血，和小青双双凌空飞跌，撞入海中。天崩地斜，漩涡滚滚，冰凉的海水登时灌满胸肺，憋闷得几欲爆炸开来了。
他张大口，狂乱地挣扎着，急速地朝那无边无际的虚空沉了下去。
身侧人影横斜，鲨鱼穿梭，小青悠悠地翻转着，衣裙鼓舞，黑发飘摇。他想要探手将她抓住，却什么也不能够着，惊怒、恐惧、悲伤、焦躁……全都如狂潮巨浪般涌上心头，窒息如扼，陡然晕了过去。
又不知过了多久，水浪声声，鸟鸣啾啾，许宣迷迷糊糊中睁开眼，阳光刺目，酸得泪水直流。用手遮在眉沿，眯眼凝望，碧海无边无垠，连接着澄澈蓝天，几只白鸥在上方欢鸣飞翔。
他心中一阵恍惚，浑然忘了此身为谁，身在何地。一阵暖风迎面吹来，花香扑鼻，转头望去，猛地大吃一惊，几乎不敢相信眼前所见。
右前方耸立着一座巨大的金色岛屿，峭壁参天，怪石丛立，赫然竟是先前那海市蜃楼中的景象。
然而让人震骇之处远不止此。
岛屿上空，竟悬浮着一座又一座的“山峰”，有的峻秀青翠，花树绵延;有的岩壁如削，寸草不生;还有的飞瀑如带，直泻入海……大小不一，形状各异，远的相隔数里，近的仅有咫尺之距。

这空中群“峰”参差错立，一山高过一山，一直向上穿过重重云海，延伸到数千丈高的碧虚。一阵大风刮来，云腾雾绕，山体也仿佛凌空微微晃动。
山与山之间，或有长藤垂蔓相连，或有浮石遥遥呼应，阳光照在那瞬息万变的云霞上，就连那道道霓虹，也仿佛成了搭架在群峰之间的彩桥。
许宣脑海中突然闪过林灵素所说的那句“蓬山百里礁，云海万重桥”，心中剧震，难道……难道此处就是蓬莱？霎时间如遭电殛，灵光霍闪，之前发生的所有事情这时才都想了起来。
但他分明记得被巨浪卷溺，沉入海底，又怎会来到这里？
转头四顾，自己竟是坐在半片葫芦里，周围碧波淼淼，礁石兀立，剩下的那半片乾坤元壶、五艘大船、魔帝、妖后…以及王文卿等神霄派道人，全都不知去向。
唯有小青浑身湿漉漉的，蜷卧在侧，右手兀自紧紧抓着他的手掌。听到“呀呀”的鸟叫声，她眉尖一蹙，蓦地惊醒起身，秋波转处，“啊”地失声低吟，俏脸上尽是惊骇迷惘之色。
波涛起伏，左摇右荡。两人脑中空茫一片，执手相看，也不知生耶死耶，是梦是醒，是真是幻。
空中鸟叫声越来越密，成千上万的禽鸟从他们头顶呀呀掠过，朝那金岛、悬山急冲而去。
content_en:
The sky and sea suddenly darkened, and the mirage suddenly disappeared. After a while, when the mirage appeared again, the woman in white was already riding a phoenix, circling the sea, fighting fiercely with the green-scaled dragon that had appeared before.
The giant dragon sometimes soars into the sky, spitting fire like clouds; sometimes it overturns rivers and seas, swallowing waves. Although they know it is just an illusion, everyone is still frightened by its ferocious power when listening to its earth-shattering roar. Their hearts beat with fear and it is difficult to concentrate their thoughts.
Only Wang Wenqing, Lin Lingsu, and Li Shaowei were unmoved. They gathered their energy to fight. White steam steamed from their heads, and their clothes were soaked with sweat.
Lin Lingsu and Li Shaowei have both reached the realm of Sanxian, and their minds are connected with each other. If the two swords were combined in the past, their power would increase dramatically. Not to mention Wang Wenqing's Five Elements Taiyi Neon Array, even if the four major Taoist sword immortals join forces, they may not be able to defeat it. But at this time, all the meridians were cut off, and they could only hold on with the help of two damage spells. The longer it took, the worse it would be for them.
Wang Wenqing saw through this, so he was not in a hurry for success. He just gathered the sword array to block the thunder and lightning, preventing the "Liang Yi Electric Sword" from being introduced into Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing's bodies, forming a human-sword fusion force. Wait until Lin and Li's thoughts are distracted or their true energy is slightly exhausted, then they will attack with all their strength.
Hearing the roar of "rumbling" again, the night sky suddenly burst into glowing light, making it difficult for everyone to open their eyes. Looking carefully, he saw in the mirage, a green dragon roaring and flying, its huge tail flying like a wild sword and hitting the phoenix, beating the divine bird to a bloody pulp and causing broken feathers to fly.
The woman in white swayed and turned into a snake shape from the waist down. She took out a five-color stone in her right hand and threw it into the sky. The stone whirled rapidly, throwing out thousands of brilliant lights, and roared towards the green dragon as it crashed down.
"Five-color stone" Lin Lingsu's palm suddenly shook and she blurted out. Li Shaowei's expression suddenly changed
Almost at the same time, there was a commotion on all the ships, and someone shouted: "Nuwa, it's Nuwa who is subduing the Qinglong." Xu Xuan was so surprised that he couldn't help but look up.
Nuwa Fulong has been around for thousands of years, so why does it appear in this mirage? If it is just an illusion, why is it so lifelike? If it is a true reflection, doesn't it mean that what Lin Lingsu said is true, and this is really where Nuwa subdued the dragon? Is it really Penglai that people have been searching for for thousands of years?
The neon light dances, illuminating the sea surface with unspeakable beauty. Everyone was like him, staring up blankly, feeling surprised, shocked, and uncertain.
Then there was a loud "boom", the glow exploded in the sky, and Nuwa, Qinglong... all disappeared into smoke. The two rolling and intertwined blazing lights suddenly flew away centrifugally like cocoons and threads, disintegrated, and were sucked into pieces by the swords around them.
Xu Xuan's eyes went dark, and his whole body felt like it was crushed into powder by the mountains. He spurted out a large mouthful of blood, and he and Xiao Qing both flew into the air and crashed into the sea. The sky collapsed and the earth tilted, the whirlpool rolled, and the cold sea water immediately filled my chest and lungs, making me feel so stuffy that I almost felt like exploding.
He opened his mouth wide, struggled wildly, and sank rapidly into the boundless void.
The figure slants sideways, sharks shuttle, Xiao Qing flips leisurely, her dress is fluttering, and her black hair is swaying. He wanted to reach out and grab her, but there was nothing he could do. Fright, anger, fear, sadness, anxiety... all came to his heart like a huge wave, suffocating him, and he suddenly fainted.
I don't know how much time passed, but there was the sound of water waves and the chirping of birds. Xu Xuan opened his eyes in a daze, and the sun was dazzling, making tears flow from his eyes. Covering the edge of the brow with his hand, he squinted and stared at the boundless blue sea, connected to the clear blue sky, with a few white gulls flying happily above.
He was in a trance, completely forgetting who he was and where he was. A gust of warm wind blew in my face, and the fragrance of flowers hit my nose. I turned around and was shocked. I could hardly believe what I saw.
A huge golden island stands in the front right, with towering cliffs and strange rocks. It is surprisingly the scene in the mirage before.
But the shock goes beyond that.
Over the island, there are floating buildings one after another.There are "peaks" one after another, some of which are steep and green, with endless flowers and trees; some of the rock walls are as thin as a blade, with no grass growing; and some of the waterfalls are like ribbons, pouring straight into the sea...different sizes and shapes, some far away are miles apart, and some close are only a few feet apart.
This group of "peaks" in the sky stands staggered and staggered, one mountain higher than the other, all the way up through the sea of ​​clouds, extending to the blue sky thousands of feet high. A strong wind blew, clouds and fog swirled around, and the mountains seemed to be shaking slightly in the sky.
Between the mountains, there may be long vines connecting them, or pumice stones echoing in the distance. The sun shines on the ever-changing clouds, and even the neon lights seem to have become colorful bridges between the peaks.
Lin Lingsu's words "Pengshan has hundreds of miles of reefs, and the sea of ​​clouds has thousands of bridges" suddenly flashed through Xu Xuan's mind. Could it be... could this be Penglai? In an instant, as if struck by lightning, a flash of light flashed through his mind, and all the things that had happened before came to mind.
But he clearly remembered being drowned by huge waves and sinking to the bottom of the sea. How did he end up here?
Turning around and looking around, he was actually sitting in half of a gourd, surrounded by clear blue waves and towering rocks. The remaining half of the Qiankun Yuan Pot, the five ships, the Demon Emperor, the Demon Queen... as well as Wang Wenqing and other Taoist priests from the Shenxiao sect were all missing.
Only Xiaoqing was wet, curled up on her side, her right hand tightly grasping his palm. When she heard the chirping of the bird, she frowned, suddenly woke up and stood up, her eyes turned around, and she muttered "Ah" in a low voice, with a look of horror and confusion on her pretty face.
The waves rise and fall, swaying left and right. Their minds were filled with confusion. They held hands and looked at each other, not knowing whether they were alive or dead, whether they were dreaming or waking up, or whether they were real illusions.
The chirping of birds in the air became thicker and louder, and thousands of birds flew over their heads, rushing towards the golden island and the hanging mountain.
